_howToAddASign: 1. Drop a short, silent clip in public/signs/clips/ (mp4 or webm).
2. Add an entry below: gloss is UPPERCASE, file is relative to basePath.
3. Reload. No rebuild, no code change — this file is read at runtime.
Aliases are the English words that should resolve to this clip.
Any gloss with no entry here is fingerspelled instead, so an empty
entries list is a working state, not a broken one.
Run `npm run manifest` to generate these entries from the clips folder.
Letter images are optional: list the ones you add in letters.available
and they replace the drawn handshape cards automatically.
